fact: The General Information Authority held a consultative meeting with ESCWA, ministries, private-sector and civil-society representatives to review the proposed National Cloud Computing Policy, a unified framework for hosting government data and services, and agreed to incorporate feedback toward its final version; the document gives no date for the event other than its published date of 2026-01-01.

ESCWA and Libya's General Information Authority held a consultative workshop on 30 December 2025 on the draft national cloud computing policy, to gather public institutions' inputs ahead of its official adoption.
